audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call Locke "a 125-range mana champ" and frame the lane as a range war Singed wins.
audit.why: Riot's kit file gives Ritual Nails (Q) 950 range and Ashen Pursuit (E) 425 range. Locke out-ranges Singed by a mile; 125 is Singed's own Fling range. The lane is not a range war — it is a grounding war over his single 10s dash.
audit.corrected: Early: he taxes you at 950 with nails. Mid: Mega Adhesive grounds Ashen Pursuit and the lane flips. Side lane / teamfights: Singed-favoured at 57.2% Emerald+ over 500 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike list names a "Lich Bane spike" for Locke and puts Purgatory at "Locke first item".
audit.why: Purgatory is his level-6 unlock on 120/100/80s, not an item spike, and no item purchase is verifiable from the kit data. Singed's own decisive spike (Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds vs Soul Ignition's end-of-duration heal-back) is missing entirely.
audit.corrected: Locke spikes: level 6 Purgatory (120/100/80s), Q rank-ups shortening Ritual Nails 10s->6s. Singed spikes: level 3 W+E, level 6 Insanity Potion (100s) applying Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive kit interactions are absent from every field: Mega Adhesive grounding Ashen Pursuit, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cutting Soul Ignition's heal-back. Silver Stake's missing-health scaling is also unstated.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive (W) carries the grounding flag; Ashen Pursuit (E) is Locke's only dash and is a flat 10s at every rank, so a grounded Locke has no entry and no exit. Insanity Potion (R) applies healing reduction to Poison Trail, and Soul Ignition (W) self-damages then heals a portion back at the end of its duration. Silver Stake (P) deals bonus on-hit magic damage increased by the target's missing health, which punishes Singed's habit of running away chipped.
audit.corrected: Hold Mega Adhesive for his step-up, not the wave — grounded, Ashen Pursuit cannot fire, and Fling into the goo roots him. Pop Insanity Potion while Soul Ignition is active so the heal-back is cut. Never limp out low: Silver Stake scales on your missing health and Purgatory executes at the floor.
